Morgan (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — opening this thread to capture concrete follow-ups on customer wins/losses and the most common asks. Keep replies short so we can triage.
Priya (CS): TL;DR from CS calls: dataset residency questions, long POC ramp, and surprise invoices for burst traffic. Customers want a clear "what we need" checklist.
Kofi (Sales): Field notes: 2 recent losses where legal demanded specific logging retention and 1 churn risk due to latency spikes during weekend promos. Wins praise hands-on onboarding and a sample connector.
Mei (Product): Proposed small set of deliverables: 1) Compliance checklist + sample contract blurb; 2) POC intake form + success metrics; 3) Billing estimator for bursty usage. I can draft 1 & 2.
Jonas (Eng): For latency we can ship quick wins: enable prefix caching by default for POCs, tune batching window, and publish a short "config suggestions" doc for traffic profiles. I can put together experiments and expected delta.
Aisha (Security): I'll assemble a network/KMS checklist and a sample logging policy snippet that satisfies SOC-type asks. ETA 8 business days.
Priya (CS): Action: I'll compile anonymized loss notes (reason tags + short root cause) so Product can use real examples. Kofi 1: can you add the two loss case summaries?
Kofi (Sales): Will post sanitized notes to #sales-docs tonight and link here.
Mei (Product): Action items I'll own: POC intake + template (ETA 5 days), compliance one-pager draft (ETA 7 days). Will include a short checklist AEs can hand customers.
Jonas (Eng): I'll push a draft "latency quick fixes" doc to the issue with benchmarks for the default configs. If we enable prefix caching by default for POCs we should call that out in the intake form.
Priya (CS): Also request: can we create a 1-page "AE collection checklist" so sales knows which docs to gather during discovery? That would speed legal reviews.
Mei (Product): Good call. Adding that to deliverables.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-3722: "all-hands: customer retro - artifacts & AE checklist" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/3722)
Morgan (CEO): Priorities: 1) compliance kit (highest), 2) POC intake + AE checklist, 3) latency config notes + billing estimator. Please add owners/dates to the issue.
Priya (CS): Scheduling a 30-min sync next Tue 10am PT to review first drafts. Invite to @here.
Kofi (Sales): Ack. I'll surface priority accounts we should contact once artifacts land.
Jonas (Eng): Quick note 1: small patch to default batching & cache could reduce median latency by ~15% on our test trace. Will include data.
Aisha (Security): I'll include the sample S3/COS policy and an example Terraform snippet for customers who want IaC.
Mei (Product): Thanks. If anyone has <1h writeups, please drop them into the GitHub issue so AEs can use immediately.
Morgan (CEO): Great. Let's close the loop fast; we should be able to demonstrate impact next quarter. :rocket:
